content.text:
I've changed the pop-up create form now. My first fix only covered the full-page form, which these example apps never show. `examples/bootstrap4/main.py:121` and `examples/sqla/admin/main.py:226` both set `create_modal = True`, so Create opens as a pop-up. That pop-up has its own Save/Cancel bar in `templates/bootstrap4/admin/model/modals/create.html`.

**What changed:** in `flask_admin/static/admin/css/bootstrap4/admin.css`, the pop-up's Save/Cancel bar now stays pinned to the bottom of the screen while you scroll a long form. Before, it sat below the last field, where your phone's browser toolbar could cover it. On phones the buttons also stack full width, so neither one gets cut off. Pop-up edit forms get the same treatment. I bumped the stylesheet version to 1.1.3 so your phone loads the new CSS instead of a cached copy.

I still haven't seen this on a phone. The sandbox blocks both PyPI and headless Chrome, so all of it is from reading the code.

If Save is still cut off after you reload, I need one of these to stop guessing:
- a screenshot from your phone
- whether Create opens as a pop-up or as its own page
- PyPI allowed in the sandbox (`pypi.org` and `files.pythonhosted.org`), so I can run the app and check it at phone width myself
